    AVG(r.review_score) AS calif, 
    julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) AS retraso
  FROM vw_pedidos_validos v
  JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = v.order_id
  WHERE v.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY v.order_id
),
rangos AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN retraso <= 0 THEN 'a_tiempo'
      WHEN retraso <= 3 THEN '1-3'
      WHEN retraso <= 7 THEN '4-7'
      WHEN retraso <= 14 THEN '8-14'
      ELSE '15+'
    END AS rango, 
    COUNT(*) AS pedidos, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN calif <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p2
  FROM pedidos
  GROUP BY rango
),
rangos_atiempo AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS pedidos, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN calif <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p2
  FROM pedidos
  WHERE retraso <= 0
)
SELECT 
  r.rango, 
  r.pedidos, 
  ROUND(100.0 * r.p2 / r.pedidos, 2) AS pct_p2, 
  ROUND(100.0 * rt.p2 / rt.pedidos, 2) AS pct_p2_atiempo
FROM rangos r
